messages:
Zoe: Quick check — console observability roadmap: where do we stand on dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestones? Need alignment ahead of Thurs review. cc @Sam @Priya
Sam: Dashboard mocks are in Figma, backend PR for metrics API is open: https://git.redwood/metrics-api/pulls/42. Blocked on RBAC change to expose read-only role.
Priya: Tracing hooks merged the instrumentation patch on main, but rollout is gated by sampling config in prod. @Marco do you have an ETA for the sampling toggle rollout?
Marco: Sampling toggle is implemented in config-service, but we need a canary plan. I can run the canary tomorrow AM. Also need to confirm who owns alert rules after rollout — is that eng-sre?
eng-sre-bot: automated note: alert templates created for initial rollout: console.error_rate, console.latency_p50. Please assign to oncall team when canary completes.
Zoe: OK blockers summary: 1) RBAC for metrics API, 2) canary plan for sampling, 3) alert ownership handoff. Who will own the RBAC change?
Sam: I can own the RBAC change. Will request a quick security review. Filing ticket: https://tracker.redwood/ISSUE-891
Priya: For error-analysis views we need 90d sample retention for the initial release. Storage team might have cost concerns — looping in @Nina.
Nina: Storage: 90 days looks feasible if we enable compaction and TTL-based snapshots. I need to run a cost estimate and will get numbers by EOD Friday, pinging billing now.
Zoe: Good. Code review pings: @Sam please add reviewers on the metrics-api PR; @Priya can you include example error-analysis queries in the PR body?
Sam: Will add reviewers and link the query examples.
Priya: Added query examples + a tiny integration test. CI flaked one test, rerunning now.
Marco: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 2h, then 20% for 6h, then full if stable. I'll publish the canary playbook to #eng-oncall before starting and include rollback steps.
Zoe: Owner proposals: Dashboards -> Sam, Tracing hooks -> Priya, Alerts -> Eng-SRE (oncall), Retention -> Nina/storage. Everyone OK with that split?
Sam: +1
Priya: +1
Nina: +1
eng-sre-bot: acknowledged: will schedule oncall handover post-canary
Zoe: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc and message PMs. If anything shifts, reply in this thread. :thumbsup:
